description: When another Actor moves a task out of the filtered column, the card disappears instantly with no animation, notice or live-region announcement. The person must go to Activity to learn what happened.
expected: A brief inline notice ('Priya moved "Refund flow…" to In progress — hidden by your filter') or an exit animation; screen readers get a polite announcement.
actual: Up next 8 → 7 silently; live region still 'Saved locally · synced'.
suggested_fix: On remote changes that remove a card from the filtered view, show a dismissible notice with the event and a link to the task.

description: The 'Conflicting edits' label on a card uses the same small muted grey text as 'Unassigned', although it signals work that needs a decision. The resolve block in the panel is strongly amber, so the card and panel disagree in emphasis.
expected: Conflict state on the card uses the warning colour/badge consistent with the amber Resolve block.
suggested_fix: Render the card conflict label as an amber badge (same token as the Resolve block).

description: Another person's 'Here now' avatar stays on the card for 30–40 s after they closed the browser, and takes 2–5 s to appear.
expected: Presence clears within a few seconds of the viewer leaving (page unload signal).
actual: PN still shown 30 s after Priya's browser closed.
suggested_fix: Send a presence 'leave' on pagehide/visibilitychange and shorten the TTL.
